name: handoff
description: Cross-product handoff context: recent cowork activity, recent code activity, and persistent strategist memory backed by Chroma.

HANDOFF_STORE_PATH.title: Handoff Store Path
HANDOFF_STORE_PATH.description: Directory where the Chroma-backed handoff store persists its data.

CODE_PROJECT_PATH.title: Code Project Path
CODE_PROJECT_PATH.description: Root directory of the code project this Handoff instance follows.

COWORK_OUTPUT_FOLDER.title: Cowork Output Folder
COWORK_OUTPUT_FOLDER.description: Optional directory containing Cowork session outputs to index.

tools.name: get_recent_cowork_context
tools.description: Return recent cowork (collaboration) activity to bring a session up to speed.

tools.name: get_recent_code_context
tools.description: Return recent code-related activity (commits, edits, reviews) for a workspace.

tools.name: query_strategist_memory
tools.description: Search the persistent strategist memory for findings relevant to a query.

tools.name: write_strategist_finding
tools.description: Persist a new strategist finding to memory for later retrieval.

tools.name: get_cross_product_brief
tools.description: Generate a brief that synthesizes context across products for a given topic.
